context: Tests whether the skill causes the agent to correctly configure mutual TLS (mTLS) for secure communication between applications and the OpenTelemetry Collector. This is a critical security pattern for production environments.

checklist.name: Explains certificate generation (CA, server cert, client cert)
checklist.description: The response includes steps to generate: CA certificate, server certificate (signed by CA), and client certificate (signed by CA). Should mention CA cert is needed for validation.

checklist.name: Configures Kubernetes secrets for certificates
checklist.description: The response shows how to create Kubernetes secrets for server and client certificates/keys and mount them into pods. Must include proper secret naming and mount paths.

checklist.name: Configures collector with client authentication
checklist.description: The collector configuration includes TLS settings that: (1) present server cert/key, (2) require client certificates, (3) validate client certs against CA. Score zero if client authentication is not enabled.

checklist.name: Configures application SDK with client certificates
checklist.description: The response shows how to configure the application SDK (environment variables or code) to present client cert/key when connecting to collector. Must show how to specify the CA cert for validation.

checklist.name: Includes certificate rotation/expiration strategy
checklist.description: The response addresses certificate rotation: either manual process, automation (cert-manager), or at minimum, documentation of when certs expire and how to update. Score zero if expiration is not mentioned.

checklist.name: Provides troubleshooting guidance for TLS errors
checklist.description: The response includes debugging tips: how to check certificate validity, verify certificate chain, check that certificates are mounted correctly. Optional but recommended.
